literal_meaning: গলায় ঢোকা বা গিলে ফেলা (the gulp went down the throat)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রশ্নের উত্তরে ঢোঁক গেলা করে বলল, 'হয়তো হবে।'
example_sentences_in_english: He hesitated in answering the question, saying, 'Maybe it will happen.'
note: This idiom metaphorically describes swallowing words due to uncertainty, common in colloquial Bengali speech.
